chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:

Umar ibn Yazeed sent me to Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal with dirhams and said, 'Say to him: if he intends to perform Hajj with it, let him perform Hajj; and if he intends to spend it, let him spend it.' I said, 'So I spent it and did not perform Hajj.' Hammad said, 'So our companions mentioned that to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), so he said: You have found the Sheikh, a jurist.'

key_terms.فَقِيهاً: a jurist / one with deep understanding

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam's praise of Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal as a 'faqih' reveal about the flexibility of Hajj funds?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the principle of *ikhtiyar* (discretion) in fiduciary matters, where the Imam’s praise of Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal as a *faqih* underscores that legal expertise involves practical judgment (*ijtihad*) rather than rigid adherence to the literal intent of the donor. Historically, this reflects the scholarly tradition of trusting qualified jurists to allocate resources where they yield greater benefit, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence regarding trusts (*amanat*) and charitable funds.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘Amar Bin Yazeed sent me to Abu Ja’far Al Ahowl with Dirhams and said,

‘Say to him that I intend the Hajj to be performed with it, so let him perform Hajj. And, if he intends to spend it, so let him spend it’. So I spent it and did not perform Hajj’. Hammad said, ‘So our companions mentioned that to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You have found the understanding Sheykh’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman who has said the following:

“‘Umar ibn Yazid sent me to abu Ja’far al-Ahwal with a certain amount of dirham and asked me to tell him to perform al-Hajj with it if he wanted, or if he wanted to benefit in other ways, he can do so. He spent it for other things and did not perform al-Hajj . Certain persons of our people mentioned it to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and he (the Imam) said, ‘You have found a faqih (knowledgeable in matters of Shari ‘ah) shaykh.’”
